findings.title: encryptQuery's declared return type omits the bare selector string it returns for searchableJson
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The return types of encryptQuery and encryptQueryBulk exclude the bare selector string that the docs and the e2e test show is returned.

findings.title: WASM searchable-JSON terms are never matched against stored rows, so a silent no-match would ship
findings.label: valid
findings.note: JSON queries through WASM are only shape-checked, and no live test confirms that WASM-minted ste_vec needles or selectors match rows in Postgres.

findings.title: Shipped JSDoc invites logging query terms that are deterministic plaintext derivatives
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The JSDoc invites logging deterministic query terms that reveal equality and order, a plausible leak caused by the documentation.
